verdict.rationale: Together's first-party batch docs describe submitting asynchronous batch workloads, including a CLI command (tg batches submit batch_input.jsonl), at up to 50% off serverless rates with a separate rate-limit pool. The discount versus real-time pricing is explicitly documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the batch discount and job workflow, and detail on per-model discount levels ("up to" 50%).
